DeployBot: ALERT: hosted-api us-west-2 embed-route p95 latency 2.5x ↑ in last 2m. Auto-rollback suppressed due to pinned release. https://dash.redwood/alerts/6789 :rotating_light:
Alex: seeing it too. Any idea if this is traffic-related or config drift?
Priya: logs show a spike of 503s from the embed proxy and elevated KV miss rate. Looks like routing manifest churn earlier.
Alex: Auto-rollback is suppressed (pin). I don't want a full revert unless necessary — unpin might be safer. OpsLead, what's your call?
OpsLead: recommend emergency unpin playbook: pause any new releases, unpin the affected route, ramp a staged traffic slice to the stable variant, keep release-notes freeze, and prepare cust comms. If latency doesn't improve on the staged slice, escalate to rollback.
Sam: +1. Rollback touches a couple DB migration flags; that path is higher-risk. Prefer unpin + staged reroute first.
Maria: CS will pull the top 5 customers on this route and prep a short message if we escalate.
Priya: need the exact unpin command and thresholds. OpsLead, can you drop the runbook snippet?
OpsLead: Runbook snippet: ```
# emergency unpin sequence
deployctl pause-all-releases --scope=us-west-2
deployctl unpin --route=embed-v2 --until=2026-03-23T14:30Z --staged=10
# monitor p95, error_rate, kv_miss for 5m. If p95 > 2x baseline or error_rate > 1% then escalate to rollback
```
Also annotate the release notes with: "emergency unpin executed — investigating latency spike".
Alex: Who will run it? I can execute the unpin if OpsLead OK. EngOncall should monitor telemetry. Maria will handle CS blurb.
OpsLead: Alex please run. EngOncall, monitor and post updates to #eng-oncall. Maria, draft a two-line customer note: what we saw, what we did, expected next update in 30m.
Alex: executing now: ```deployctl unpin --route=embed-v2 --until=2026-03-23T14:30Z --staged=10```
DeployBot: Action acknowledged: unpin started. Staged slice 10% -> ramping. https://deploy.redwood/actions/9991
EngOncall: telemetry: at 10% slice p95 trending down, now within 1.1x baseline after 90s. Continuing 5m observation window.
Priya: KV miss ratio down from 18% -> 6%, error spikes subsiding. Looks like manifest routing was the culprit.
OpsLead: Good. Ramp plan: 10% -> 25% after 5m stable -> 50% after next 5m. Keep change window locked for 60m. No other merges.
Maria: CS draft ready: "We observed a temporary latency increase affecting embeddings in us-west-2. We unpinned the recent release and staged traffic to a stable variant; latency is improving. We'll send a follow-up in 30 minutes." Ready to send once we confirm 50% ramp.
Alex: Locking change window and release-notes freeze now. Starting postmortem doc skeleton: https://docs.redwood/pm/emergency-unpin-6789. Thanks all :thumbsup:
